Name: MissCoriel's Supplement Pack 4 Artisians and Ranchers
Author: MissCoriel
TagLine: Leah, Marnie, and Clint needed a track for themselves.. Now their homes have unique music.
Description:
Mostly, this exists to test the ability to add music beyond the game limitations.  These three tracks **DO NOT** replace any of the default music.
Each was handcrafted and encoded with high quality!

Listen to the Artisan and Ranchers Pack!
[soundcloud]https://soundcloud.com/evilpickle-music-dept/sets/artisans-and-ranchers[/soundcloud]

Installation is easy!

1.  Download and install [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/)

2.  Download [Custom Music](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043) and place in your Mods Folder

3.  Place the unzipped music pack into your Mods folder
For those who want to use it in events the music IDs will be

cm:LeahHouse, cm:MarnieHouse, cm:ClintHouse
